about_the_game:
Get ready for a fast-paced adventure in BoostRush, a 3D jetpack platformer where timing and reflexes are everything!

Control a daring character with a powerful jetpack and fly across floating platforms, avoiding tricky obstacles and dangerous gaps.

Master your boost timing to stay in the air, make precise landings, and conquer the only level filled with challenging jumps and dynamic hazards.

Simple to play but difficult to master, BoostRush is all about perfecting your run and chasing your best performance.

With colorful visuals and energetic gameplay, it's a fun and intense experience whether you're playing for a quick session or aiming for a flawless run.

How far can your jetpack take you?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or AMD R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible soundcard
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 (12 GB) or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible soundcard

short_description: Fly through challenging floating platforms in BoostRush! Control your jetpack, dodge obstacles, and master your jumps in this fast-paced 3D platformer. Customize your hero and race against gravity across vibrant levels full of excitement and danger.
